items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Nat Cole come out of there? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, because Nat, you know, when Hamp was going -- was there drumming, he went in -- I went into the National Guard band --

ctx.x: That's true. Milt Hinton (Unintelligible) and Hampton, bunch of them came out of that school.
And Nat Cole come out of there?
Yeah, because Nat, you know, when Hamp was going -- was there drumming, he went in -- I went into the National Guard band --
